children: of its Muse personal agent, Meta Platforms
is “well positioned” if artificial intelligence agents become “the third S-curve in AI,” Cantor Fitzgerald said.

“Meta, in our view, is well positioned to be a leading beneficiary of this theme with a competitive model that is specifically trained to lead in agentic tasks, a strong harness with a differentiated UX in Muse, and a massive compute infrastructure that can help META scale personal agents rapidly into its user base ahead of competition,” Cantor analyst Deepak Mathivanan wrote in a note to clients. “We believe the unit economics of Muse are being subsidized in the early days, but we think META has several paths to a profitable freemium model.”
Mathivanan reiterated his Overweight rating on Meta and upped his price target to $860 from $680.
Delving deeper, Mathivanan said he believes the size of the personal agent total addressable market could be as big as $1T.

“The revenue potential over the long-term can be reasonably estimated as $250B+ under a narrow definition (subscriptions + commerce commissions) and over $1T using a broad scope (time saved x value of time),” Mathivanan explained. ”Smartphones, which improved online experiences, currently drive over $600B+ in revenues (advertising, commissions, and subscriptions). Personal agents, if usage takes off, could become a larger end-market over time.”

The analyst also noted that Meta has the “right combination” of model architecture, harness, and user interface to drive even further adoption of Muse. The app, introduced earlier this month, has rocketed to the top of the App Store and caused sell-offs in various industries amid fears of disruption.
“META’s smart UX design with Feed and Recommendations are well suited for capturing multiple engagement models in the app (chat, feed, and ideas),” Mathivanan explained.
The analyst also noted there are “many paths” for Meta to monetize the Muse app and turn it into a profitable freemium business.

“We calculate that META is incurring 25c per task (or $11 per average user on a monthly basis) to support Muse at launch,” Mathivanan wrote. “That said, AI inference margins improve meaningfully with scale and model advancements. We think META has several paths to lower cost per task by 80%+ in the next 18-24 months and the company can operate Muse profitably on a stand-alone basis with a freemium business model.”

title: Meta is 'well positioned' as Cantor Fitzgerald says agents could be 'the third S-curve in AI'
